identity.name: E1_Fintech_Control_Room
identity.core_philosophy: Information density without clutter. Every pixel must earn its rent.

usage_rules.headings: Use 'Chivo' for page titles and major section headers. Weight: 700 or 900. Tracking: -0.02em.
usage_rules.body: Use 'Inter' for labels, navigation, and general text. Weight: 400 or 500.
usage_rules.data: CRITICAL: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL financial data (prices, P&L, ratios). This ensures tabular alignment. Weight: 500.

grids.dashboard_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6

bento_rules.control_panel: col-span-full row-span-1 flex justify-between items-center bg-card border-t border-border p-4

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium text-sm
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20 hover:bg-destructive/20 rounded-sm
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Use 'border-r border-border/40' on grid items to create a technical, structured look.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Overlay a subtle repeating linear gradient (opacity 0.02) to simulate a monitor screen.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use on the 'Active Strategy' card to indicate live execution.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use only for sticky headers: bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/50.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
motion.ticker: Use a slow, continuous marquee for the stock ticker at the top.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Use 'text-foreground' on 'bg-background'.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background on all interactive elements.
accessibility.screen_readers: Use aria-label on all icon-only buttons.

image_urls.description: Wall Street Sign (B&W) - Use for Login/Landing background with heavy overlay.
Digital Numbers Matrix - Use as a subtle texture overlay in the 'System Health' section.
Laptop with Analytics - Use for 'About' or 'Documentation' page hero.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-performance trading dashboard. Speed and clarity are paramount. Do not use unnecessary animations that slow down the UI. Data must be legible at a glance.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_strategy: Implement the 'Control Room' grid. Use dense spacing. Avoid large empty white spaces. This is a tool for professionals, not a marketing site.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_overrides: Customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners (set radius to 0 or sm). Use 'border-border' for all borders. Ensure 'dark' mode is always active.

specific_components.name: KillSwitch
specific_components.instruction: Create a dedicated component for the 'Kill Switch'. It must be red, distinct, and require a confirmation dialog. It should be placed in the header or a persistent control bar.

specific_components.name: PnLTicker
specific_components.instruction: Implement a scrolling ticker at the top of the dashboard showing live prices for SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, NVDA, META.

specific_components.name: RegimeIndicator
specific_components.instruction: Visual component showing current market regime (e.g., 'Bull Volatile', 'Bear Quiet'). Use color coding (Green/Red) and a gauge or simple badge.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers only.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in marketing sections, but keep dashboard sections DENSE.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
